_comment: Loadable sample decks for edot slides (File ▸ Samples). 'file' is resolved by the app relative to this folder; slides.html lives at magpie/edot/slides/ so the app uses ../../../third_party/slide-examples/ as the base. Add an entry + drop the .json alongside — nothing else to change. All decks here are authored-for-edot, CC0. See README.md for provenance.

samples.title: Corporate (boring QBR)
samples.note: Title, agenda, bulleted content, two-column, thank-you. Neutral theme. CC0.

samples.title: Arty (Keynote-style)
samples.note: Big type, full-bleed abstract SVG art backgrounds (generated, CC0). Image-forward.

samples.title: Equations (Unicode math)
samples.note: Famous formulas as Unicode math. Note: our PPTX export emits text, not OMML. CC0.

samples.title: Multilingual & RTL
samples.note: English + Arabic + Hebrew + CJK mixed in the same slides. A bidi test. CC0.

samples.title: Torture test (edge cases)
samples.note: Long bullets, deep indents, emoji/specials, empty slide, image-only, 16 slides. CC0.
